decisions.reason: Its move from a brief mention to a dedicated page in 2024 signals reduced uncertainty and positive option value, so the option should be kept open.
A dedicated page in both years and a 2024 product-specific launch indicate strong commitment and realized value, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
After two years it still has only a brief mention and no dedicated page, revealing weak prospects relative to other options, so the option should be abandoned.
Launched only in 2024 and still early, its uncertainty remains high while keeping costs are low, so it should be kept open.
As a 2024 service, it is an early-stage option whose value is still uncertain and it is not yet costly to keep, so keep.
